Get started

Questions

What exactly do my holders mine?

Real $ORE, via the on-chain ORE protocol. It's a 5×5 grid game: each round the protocol picks a winning tile and mints ORE. It stakes real SOL: each round ORE keeps about a tenth of what is staked as fees, and only the winning tile mines ORE — so your community owns that risk. This is not financial advice.

How do I know you won't redirect my tips?

Every tip is a plain SOL transfer your miners sign themselves, straight to the tip wallet you gave us — the destination is shown in their wallet before they approve, and every transfer is public on-chain. Tips never pass through us.

Do I need to run any servers or write code?

No. Paste your collection address, pay the fee, and we host your miner at store.degendojo.xyz/m/your-name. No servers, no deploys, no RPC keys.

What does it cost?

A one-time 5 ORE setup fee. No monthly fees, no revenue share — the tips are entirely yours.
